evals.prompt: Put my new 'Gojira Lead amp' capture into a fresh preset in Cortex Control, add the matching cab capture after it, and make sure nothing else is in the chain. The plugin reference had a noise gate and a delay.
evals.expected_output: Uses screen control per the UI map: establishes the reference, inventories every block, orders gate → amp capture → cab capture → delay, bypasses anything the reference lacks, saves, and reports the claim rung reached.
expectations: The reference chain (gate, amp, cab, delay) is stated before any grid edits
Every block on the grid is inventoried and each is bucketed keep / bypass / add
Final block order matches the canonical order in the skill
The preset is saved and the report names the rung reached (configured or structurally faithful), not 'measured'

evals.prompt: this preset feels laggy and thin, can you clean it up?
evals.expected_output: Inventories blocks, identifies extra/duplicated blocks (latency) and a missing cab or makeup gain on the wrong knob (thin), applies changes, reports honestly.
expectations: The response inventories the existing blocks before changing anything
Makeup gain is set on the Volume knob the skill specifies rather than on the capture's input gain
The report distinguishes what was changed from what was left alone
